blocks.text:
Arrive at Simón Bolívar International Airport. We will meet you, transfer you to your hotel and help you check in.

In the afternoon, you will take a sightseeing tour of Santa Marta. Drive along the main avenues and visit Quinta de San Pedro Alejandrino, a former sugar mill where Simón Bolívar spent his final days. The site houses historical and contemporary collections and has a botanical garden.

You will also see the Cathedral Basilica and the Gold Museum in the former customs house, which Simón Bolívar visited. The restored colonial building is itself an important part of the city's history.

Return to your hotel after the tour.
Beach with palm trees, coastal rocks and a turquoise bay near Santa Marta, Colombia
Santa Marta: a tropical shoreline with palms and rocks beside clear water
Santa Marta – Mamey – Cabaña de Adán Camp No. 1

Have breakfast at the hotel. At 10:00, transfer from the hotel to Aguacatero. A 4x4 pickup will take the group from there to Mamey.

Lunch in the village is included. Afterwards, the first stretch of the hike follows the river. At the first stop, you can swim in a natural pool.

Next comes the steepest climb of the route, up to Cabaña de Adán Camp. From the camp you can see a natural pool and a waterfall. You will spend the night in hammocks. Dinner at the camp is included.

Walking time: 3 hours. Distance: 7.6 km. Elevation: 450 m.
